title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
summary: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered is Atari's remaster of the 2002 kaiju fighting game, with a Switch 2 release date of November 3, 2026 and a price of $29.99. It is one of the smallest Switch 2 games we track: the pre-release listing puts it at 3.9 GB, which may change at launch but will not be a storage problem either way. The physical version has the full game on the cartridge, so you can play it straight from the box. It supports up to 4 players on one console and 2 online, which suits its arcade-style fights. The eShop lists six languages, including Spanish. Performance figures have not been published yet.
